verdict.rationale: Grok's docs describe a connectors ecosystem (built-in OAuth connectors, Salesforce, custom API-based connectors) that a user can add to the assistant, matching the spirit of a connector directory, but there is no explicit evidence of a browsable in-app 'app store' UI or third-party marketplace beyond a handful of named integrations. missing for 10: evidence of an actual browsable directory/marketplace UI listing many third-party apps, independent user reports of browsing and adding connectors.
